block.topic_broadcast.model.title: Topic Broadcast
block.topic_broadcast.modal_hint: In Active Runtime, the input publishes on this topic first. The block then receives that publication and copies it to its output.
block.topic_broadcast.description: Publishes the input on this topic and replicates every received event to the output.
block.topic_broadcast.inspector_hint: The input publishes on the topic first. The output is emitted after the topic is received, including for this block's own publication.
